note: MYTHOS Vault — credential inventory, MYTHOS_VAULT_ARCHITECTURE §10 step 1 (metadata-only; the one step the ADR allows without a new owner decision). Every entry records that a credential EXISTS, who owns it, where, with what mode, which environment variable NAME carries it, who consumes it, and its lifecycle status. No entry holds a value and no field ever may (lib/inventory.js refuses value-bearing keys and secret-shaped content). Entries are the references (cred_…) the MCP registry and every future consumer name instead of a path or a value. bin/vault-inventory-check verifies existence, owner and mode by stat() only — it never opens a listed file.

excluded.reason: MYTHOS_VAULT_ARCHITECTURE §3: the governance signing key stays outside any credential layer permanently — a credential layer must never be able to authorise its own modification.
